title: Ramsey theory and topological dynamics of 0-dimensional flows
summary: We introduce several Ramsey-theoretic properties of 0-dimensional ambits and obtain their dynamical characterizations. In consequence, we obtain Ramsey-theoretic criteria for triviality and for profiniteness of some important invariants (in particular, of the Ellis groups) of the ambits in question. This yields a criterion for the structural property that each distal minimal factor of the given ambit is a profinite flow.
